ch01.before: Zhang Huichong was a legend of the Chinese screen
ch01.alt: Two black-and-white photographs: at left, the magician and film star Zhang Huichong holding a large crystal ball with a woman's face reflected inside it; at right, a stage tableau of his Shanghai-style magic act, performers in Chinese costume beside a latticed cabinet.
ch01.caption: Zhang Huichong (left) and his Shanghai-style magic in performance (right), which once swept Republican-era Shanghai.

ch01.before: There was arrogance in Gu Shunzhang
ch01.alt: Two clippings from the Shanghai newspaper Shen Bao: a dense column of boxed notices, one headed 'Qixing Magic Research Society'; and a newspaper page carrying an illustrated advertisement for a magic performance.
ch01.caption: Advertisements and reports in the Shen Bao concerning "Hua Guangqi," 9 November and 1 December 1930.

ch01.before: Underground in Shanghai, Chen Geng was here and gone
ch01.alt: A black-and-white photograph of Chen Geng in a soft cap and round spectacles, smiling, in the rough clothes of his Shanghai disguise.
ch01.caption: Chen Geng.

ch01.alt: A black-and-white portrait photograph of Li Weihan in a jacket and tie.
ch01.caption: Li Weihan.

ch01.alt: A black-and-white portrait photograph of the labor leader Su Zhaozheng in a jacket and tie.
ch01.caption: Su Zhaozheng.

ch01.before: But on 14 November 1927, the Provisional Central Politburo held
ch01.alt: An organizational tree diagram. At the top, a box labeled 'Provisional Central Politburo' enclosing 'Standing Committee.' Below, flanked by the Party Newspaper Committee at left and the Labor Movement Committee at right, a box labeled 'Organization Bureau.' Beneath it, a row of section boxes: Women's Movement Committee, Special-Service, Military, Publication-and-Distribution, Investigation, Propaganda, Organization, Accounts, Courier, and Secretariat.
ch01.caption: The Party's central structure after the reorganization of 14 November 1927, from Central Circular No. 17, "On the Party's Organizational Work."

ch01.alt: A black-and-white photograph of a crowded street demonstration in Shanghai, marchers carrying tall banners past shopfronts.
ch01.caption: A mass march in the Shanghai streets during the May Thirtieth movement.

ch01.alt: A black-and-white photograph of an elderly Xu Meikun seated in a wicker chair, in a light jacket and glasses.
ch01.caption: Xu Meikun.

ch01.alt: A black-and-white photograph of a line of armed Shanghai workers' pickets standing with rifles before a wall, a crowd gathered behind them.
ch01.caption: Shanghai workers' pickets of the Great Revolution period.
